assembly.name: Body shell (real Mk7 mesh)
assembly.description: A real Mk7 Golf body mesh (draco-compressed to 2.6 MB, palette recoloured to the operator's white) dropped in through the data-driven geometryRef path — the hero-mesh upgrade the architecture was designed for. The schematic panel view is default-hidden; use the tree's eye icons to swap between them.

parts.name: Body shell (real mesh)
parts.description: Real Golf body mesh (draco-compressed GLB, swapped in via the data-driven geometryRef path — zero viewer changes). Toggle this and the schematic panels with the tree's eye icons to switch between the lifelike shell and the clickable panel view.
